His brother trains in Sydney and his father once sent Quest For More to Flemington. Now Cumberland Plate record-breaker Wine Dark Sea gives Harry Charlton a Melbourne Cup runner of his own, with Damian Lane booked to ride.
其弟於悉尼擔任練馬師，而其曾部署「追逐無盡」（Quest For More）遠征費明頓。此時此刻，打破紀錄的 Cumberland Plate 冠軍 Wine Dark Sea 讓查鏗義亦訓練出一匹可以出戰墨爾本盃的賽駒，並已確定由連達文主轡。
